name: ts
description: Event timestamp (ms since epoch, client clock)

name: kind
description: Event discriminator: session_init | message_updated | part_updated | session_diff | session_deleted | session_close

name: sessionID
description: Session the event belongs to (subagent ID if applicable)

name: rootSessionID
description: Set on session_init only; path derives it elsewhere

name: info
description: Session.Info or MessageV2.Info depending on kind

name: spilledBlobSha
description: SHA-256 of a tool output spilled to tool-results/<sha>.txt
